en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a very large, multi‑storey brick institutional building in a late 19th / early 20th century historicist style. The long façade features steep tiled roofs with dormers, small towers and gables, tall narrow windows, and decorative brickwork. In front of the building is a tree‑lined street or path and a low fence; in the foreground there is an open cultivated field with low plants and a dirt track. The image has a wide landscape format and no visible caption on the front.
